set.typical_award_size: City page states about $165,000 per year, but the County's 2027 Action Plan NOFA estimates Paso Robles' 2027 CDBG share at $295,492 ($192,070 available for project applications after admin and the 15% public services cap). At least 70% must benefit low income persons (80% AMI or below), no more than 15% for public services, up to 30% for blight elimination; projects must complete within about 1.5 years. CDBG cannot pay new housing construction costs or development impact fees; eligible uses include land acquisition for low income housing, street improvements serving low income housing, rehabilitation and public facilities.
